items.title: AT&T (T) Joins Skilled Trades Coalition Targeting 1 Million Workers By 2035
items.summary: AT&T (NYSE:T) joins the Lowe's Foundation as a founding corporate partner in the new Building Futures Skilled Trades Coalition. The coalition includes companies such as NVIDIA and General Motors and targets training and certification for 1 million skilled trades workers by 2035. The effort is aimed at addressing the U.S. skilled trade workforce gap that affects infrastructure projects and broader economic resilience.
